correctness.rationale: For distinct full-alphabet strings at distance one or two, a common radius-one output is obtained by keeping one center (distance one) or matching one center at one differing coordinate and the other at the second (distance two). Distance at least three excludes any common output. Independent replay, using embedded inputs checked for exact agreement with CERTIFICATE.json, regenerated all square-free sources with counts (3,6,12,18,30,42,60,78,108), verified that the n=6 and n=7 confusable pairs partition their respective source sets (bounds 21 and 30), and checked nonnegative exact weights on every n=8 and n=9 ball. Each ball received weight one with total budgets 63/2 and 48, so disjointness gives the integral upper bounds 31 and 48. The five n=9 orbits had 48 distinct legal centers and passed all 1,128 pair checks. Thus the integer maximum at nine is 48, with all earlier maxima <32; no exact n=8 value is established.
